goal: Simplify the libbitcoinkernel C API by removing redundant genesis and tip accessor functions
Reduce public interface surface where existing height-based lookups already fulfill the same role
reviewability: Author has been silent for 311 days, so a review may wait a long time for a response
agreement: Concept approval because dedicated iterators make these specialized accessors redundant (TheCharlatan)
Resolved objection: rare reorg lowering chain height could throw an uncaught exception (maflcko)

why: P3 because trimming redundant accessors simplifies the public C API surface before stabilization
